subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - owners & milestones
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - owners & milestones

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery call I’m attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration build plan milestone you asked for: SDK integration, streaming responses, tool-calling, and structured outputs. This thread is the working doc for owners and milestone dates.

Key asks from call:
- Confirm owner contacts on your side for engineering / product reviews.
- Agree on target close date for the integration milestone (recommended: 2027-01-15).
- Confirm any blocking dependencies (data access, internal security review, sandbox credentials).

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- SDK integration: Marissa Cole (integration PM / principal engineer)
- Streaming & low-latency config: Alex Martinez (runtime engineering)
- Tool-calling & structured output mappings: Camila Reyes (platform integrations)
- Redwood point-of-contact and escalation: Ben Carter (Account Exec)

Proposed milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & requirements sign-off — target: 2026-11-30
2) SDK integration PoC (basic generation + auth) — target: 2026-12-15
3) Streaming & KV caching validation — target: 2026-12-29
4) Tool-calling + structured output contract & tests — target: 2027-01-08
5) Integration handoff & go/no-go — target: 2027-01-15

Attachments: acme-map-integration-MAP-v2.pdf (MAP draft), sdk-integration-spec.md (integration checklist)

Next steps: please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/dates by EOD Monday. If you want to adjust targets we can workshop with your eng leads.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

[Attachment: acme-map-integration-MAP-v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: sdk-integration-spec.md (markdown)]

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - owners & milestones

Thanks Ben — appreciate the recap and the MAP draft. Quick responses from our side:

- Acme owners:
  - Eng lead / SDK: Carlos Rivera (cc’d)
  - Platform / streaming: Priya Shah (not cc’d yet — I’ll loop her in on Monday)
  - Integrations / SDET: Maya Patel (I’ll send contact details)

- Targets: the proposed targets look reasonable. One ask: can we push the SDK PoC target to 2026-12-20 to accommodate our year-end freeze? Otherwise 2027-01-15 for final handoff is fine.

- Blocking items:
  - Sandbox credentials for Acme test org (we need Redwood to generate a sandbox API key and test dataset),
  - SOC2 questionnaire follow-up (security team flagged a couple of items) — I’ll send the list.

I’ll follow up Monday with Priya and Maya. For now, please mark SDK PoC target as 2026-12-20.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Product | Acme Corp
emily.zhang@acme.com

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - owners & milestones

Thanks Ben and Emily — quick internal notes and owner confirmations from Redwood: 

- I’ll take point on SDK integration work (integration PM + lead engineer). Deliverables: auth flow, sample SDK calls, example quickstart, code snippets for iOS/Android/Node.
- Alex will run streaming validation and KV caching tests; he’ll produce perf numbers for the sequences you outlined.
- Camila will own tool-calling and structured output contract: mapping of Acme tool actions -> Redwood function interface, sample JSON schema for outputs, integration tests.

I’ll update the MAP (Drive link) to reflect the adjusted SDK PoC date: 2026-12-20. Also adding a dependency: Redwood needs seed test data from Acme by 2026-11-27 to hit the PoC target.

Open question for Acme: who will own generating the sandbox test dataset and who will approve access?

I’ll set up a short kickoff for next week (30 min) to walk through the MAP and the SDK checklist. Proposed times: Tue 2026-11-23 10:00 or 14:00 PT.

—Marissa

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed updates: 

- Updated targets:
  - Kickoff & requirements sign-off — 2026-11-30
  - SDK integration PoC — 2026-12-20 (confirmed)
  - Streaming & KV caching validation — 2026-12-29
  - Tool-calling + structured output tests — 2027-01-08
  - Integration handoff & go/no-go — 2027-01-15

- Redwood owners: Marissa (SDK), Alex (streaming), Camila (tool-calling). Ben (AE) escalation.
- Acme owners: Carlos (eng lead), Priya Shah (streaming), Maya Patel (SDET) — Emily to introduce Priya/Maya by EOD Tue.
- Dependencies: Acme to provide sandbox credentials and seed data by 2026-11-27; Redwood to share SOC2 questionnaire responses by 2026-11-24 (I’ll coordinate).

I’ve attached the updated MAP (v2) and the integration checklist. I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue Nov 23 10:00 PT — Marissa, Alex, Camila, please confirm. Emily / Carlos, if that time doesn’t work we can move to 14:00 PT.
